summary: Security audit of Win-11-Debloat repository reveals critical structural deficiencies. Only 5 of 55+ documented modules are implemented (~9% completion). Critical bugs include firewall rules that silently fail (hostname vs IP mismatch), race conditions in rollback infrastructure, SKU-dependent telemetry settings applied unconditionally, and multiple syntax errors in runtime scripts. The codebase requires significant remediation before production use.

issues.description: AllowTelemetry=0 only works on Enterprise SKU. On Home/Pro it gets clamped to 1. Script sets it to 0 unconditionally without checking Windows SKU, causing silent failure on non-Enterprise editions.
issues.fix_suggested: Add SKU detection: `(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).OperatingSystemSKU` and set AllowTelemetry=1 for Home/Pro (SKU 48, 49, 98, 100, 101) or warn user that full disable requires Enterprise/Education.

issues.description: Script creates new backup directory on each run without checking if telemetry is already disabled. Re-running accumulates orphan backup directories in C:\ProgramData\WinOptimizer\backup\.
issues.fix_suggested: Check current state before creating backup. If already in desired state, skip backup creation and exit early with 'already applied' message.

issues.description: Metadata uses non-standard field names (whatChanges, riskLevel, previewCommand) inconsistent with CONTRIBUTING.md documented schema (preview_cmd, apply_cmds, rollback_cmds, verify, dependencies).
issues.fix_suggested: Standardize metadata schema across all modules and update CONTRIBUTING.md to match actual implementation, or vice versa.

issues.description: Kills WebExperience processes as side effect. While process may not exist on re-run (acceptable), backup directory still gets new timestamp each run, orphaning old backups.
issues.fix_suggested: Check if widgets already disabled before creating backup. Use consistent backup naming or cleanup old backups for same module.

issues.description: Metadata schema inconsistent with CONTRIBUTING.md documentation.
issues.fix_suggested: Align metadata fields with documented schema.

issues.description: Verify script logic is inverted. Lines 11-13 check if service StartType is 'Disabled' and flag it as a problem. But apply.ps1 sets services to 'Manual', not 'Disabled'. Verify will incorrectly pass even if services are re-enabled to Automatic.
issues.fix_suggested: Change verify logic to check for Manual or Disabled as success states: `if ($service.StartType -notin @('Manual', 'Disabled')) { $issues++ }`

issues.description: Metadata schema inconsistent with CONTRIBUTING.md documentation.
issues.fix_suggested: Align metadata fields with documented schema.

issues.description: No unit tests exist for this module.
issues.fix_suggested: Create tests/unit/modules/disable-xbox-services.tests.ps1 with service state validation tests.

issues.description: Firewall rules use hostnames (e.g., vortex-win.data.microsoft.com) in -RemoteAddress parameter. New-NetFirewallRule's -RemoteAddress does NOT resolve DNS names—it expects IP addresses, CIDR blocks, or ranges. These rules will silently fail to match any traffic, providing false sense of security.
issues.fix_suggested: Resolve hostnames to IPs at apply time using [System.Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses(), or maintain a curated list of Microsoft telemetry IP ranges. Consider using CIDR blocks for known Microsoft ranges.

issues.description: Specification document mentions WaaSMedicSvc (Windows Update Medic) at line 124 with warning 'do NOT disable unless you control updates'. This is a PROTECTED component per CLAUDE.md. While the warning is present, listing it at all in an optimization context creates confusion and risk.
issues.fix_suggested: Remove WaaSMedicSvc from specification entirely, or move to a dedicated 'NEVER TOUCH' reference section that explicitly states these are listed only for awareness, not action.

issues.description: No unit or integration tests exist for this module.
issues.fix_suggested: Create firewall rule validation tests that verify rules exist and have correct properties.

issues.description: Duplicate command: Set-ItemProperty for DefaultConsent appears twice consecutively, wasting execution time.

Rollback script restores WER Disabled registry value but does NOT restore the DefaultConsent value that apply.ps1 sets. This is a partial rollback, violating the 'complete rollback' requirement in CLAUDE.md.
issues.fix_suggested: Add restoration of DefaultConsent value from backup in rollback.ps1. Ensure backup captures both Disabled and DefaultConsent values.

issues.description: No unit or integration tests exist for this module.
issues.fix_suggested: Create tests/unit/modules/disable-wer.tests.ps1 with WER service and registry state validation.

runtime_issues.description: Uses Invoke-Expression to execute commands from metadata, allowing command injection if metadata.yaml is malformed or tampered with. PSScriptAnalyzer rule PSAvoidUsingInvokeExpression would flag this.
runtime_issues.fix_suggested: Replace Invoke-Expression with direct script invocation using & operator: `& $scriptPath @params` or use Start-Process with proper argument escaping.

runtime_issues.description: Invalid PowerShell syntax using inline if expression in parameter position. PowerShell does not support ternary expressions in this context prior to PS7.
runtime_issues.fix_suggested: Use a preceding variable: `$color = if ($manifest.riskLevel -eq 'HIGH') { 'Red' } else { 'Yellow' }; Write-Host -ForegroundColor $color ...`

runtime_issues.description: Invalid PowerShell syntax: '-if' is not a valid parameter. Should be '-ForegroundColor'.
Export-ModuleMember used in .ps1 file. This cmdlet only works inside .psm1 module files. Will throw error when dot-sourced.
runtime_issues.fix_suggested: Either rename utils.ps1 to utils.psm1 and import as module, or remove Export-ModuleMember and rely on dot-sourcing exposing all functions.

runtime_issues.description: CLAUDE.md requires JSON structured logging to C:\ProgramData\WinOptimizer\logs\. The Write-Log function writes plaintext, not JSON format.
runtime_issues.fix_suggested: Modify Write-Log to output JSON: `@{timestamp=$timestamp; layer=$layer; operation=$operation; result=$result} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Out-File -Append $logPath`

runtime_issues.description: All rollback scripts use 'find latest backup directory' pattern. If multiple modules create backups at the same timestamp second, or if a different layer's backup is newer, rollback will restore wrong data. This is a fundamental architectural flaw.
runtime_issues.fix_suggested: Use module-specific backup directories: `C:\ProgramData\WinOptimizer\backup\{layer}\{module-id}\{timestamp}\`. Rollback should only search within its own module directory.

ci_recommendations.description: ci.yml uses 'PowerShell/PowerShell@v2' action which does not exist. windows-latest runners already have PowerShell installed.
ci_recommendations.fix_suggested: Remove the PowerShell setup action. Use 'shell: pwsh' or 'shell: powershell' in run steps instead.

ci_recommendations.description: Integration test creates system restore point on GitHub Actions runner. Ephemeral VMs likely don't support System Restore, causing silent failure.
ci_recommendations.fix_suggested: Mock or skip restore point creation in CI. Add conditional: `if (-not $env:CI) { Checkpoint-Computer ... }`

ci_recommendations.description: release.yml GPG signing step has `if: runner.os == 'Linux'` but runs on `self-hosted-windows-signer`. Condition will never be true, GPG signing will never execute.
ci_recommendations.fix_suggested: Change condition to `if: always()` or configure GPG for Windows, or run signing on Linux runner.

ci_recommendations.description: release.yml references scripts/package.ps1 and scripts/package-and-sign.ps1 which do not exist in the repository. Release workflow will fail.
ci_recommendations.fix_suggested: Create the missing packaging scripts or update workflow to use existing build mechanism.

ci_recommendations.description: Uses deprecated upload-artifact@v3. Should upgrade to v4.
ci_recommendations.fix_suggested: Update to `actions/upload-artifact@v4` with updated syntax for artifact naming.

ci_recommendations.description: No pre-commit hook to enforce non-executable file permissions or run PSScriptAnalyzer before commit.
ci_recommendations.fix_suggested: Add .pre-commit-config.yaml with PSScriptAnalyzer linting and permission checks.

ci_recommendations.description: Script files lack '# RUN INSIDE WINDOWS VM OR CI ONLY' annotation as implied by spec documentation.
ci_recommendations.fix_suggested: Add standardized header comment to all apply.ps1 and rollback.ps1 files indicating execution environment requirements.
